verdict.rationale: Martin explicitly supports scheduled/recurring background tasks (daily/weekly briefings, wake-up calls, reminders, email triage, proactive drafts) and one-off scheduling via shortcuts and cc-to-schedule, with results delivered back via email/Slack/call. Community evidence corroborates real usage of background agent tasks (todo management, briefings) though also notes reliability concerns being actively addressed. Missing for 10: independent verification of scheduling reliability at scale and more detail on flexible custom recurring task creation beyond named presets.
